name: Amcom Telecommunications
summary: Perth-based telco (fibre, DSL broadband, voice, data centres; also retail via Amnet brand); carrier-licensed 1998 with cabling-business roots dating to 1988; acquired IP Systems (2010); acquired by Vocus 2015.

events.details: Became a licensed telecommunications carrier and began building its Perth fibre network. Origins: Amcom Telecommunications Pty Ltd registered in WA 19 Aug 1988 (ACN 009 336 341) by Andrew McLean as a structured-cabling provider for Perth CBD corporates — the business founding, though pre-telco. The ASX entity (AMM) was the former mining shell International Mineral Resources NL (listed Jul 1994), renamed Fibertel Ltd Nov 1999 after buying into Amcom, then Amcom Telecommunications Limited on 13 Jun 2000.
